descripcion_geo: City and river in northern Syria (modern Tell Halaf/Habur) where Israelites were deported from the northern kingdom.
importancia_estrategica: Fate of the Israelite exile deported by the Assyrians.

historias.titulo: The ten tribes deported to Gozan
historias.descripcion: The Assyrians deported the northern Israelites 'to Hala, Gozan by the river Habor and to the cities of the Medes'.

historias.titulo: The gods of Gozan: Assyrian argument
historias.descripcion: Sennacherib asks: 'Did the gods of Gozan and Haran deliver those lands from my hand?'

historias.titulo: Hezekiah and the deportees from Gozan
historias.descripcion: The mention of Gozan as the destination of the Israelite exile reinforces the Assyrian argument that no god can resist them.

personajes.descripcion: He deported Israelites to Gozan; Their descendants are the 'ten lost tribes'.
He used Gozan as an example of his power to intimidate Hezekiah.
He responded to the threats Gozan cited with prayer; the Lord responded.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Gozan: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: The deportation to Gozan marks the beginning of the 'ten lost tribes': Israel from the north scattered among the towns with no recorded return.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The deportation to Gozan marks the beginning of the 'ten lost tribes': Israel from the north scattered among the towns with no recorded return.
